cases.task: Fix the oracle permission preset without changing the format generated by any harness.
cases.notes: Start with createAgents and its tests; load harness packaging only if generated output also changes.

cases.task: Add validation to a CLI dry-run argument without changing the installed artifact.
cases.notes: The parser, help, and CLI tests are sufficient while the writer remains unchanged.

cases.task: Change how the Codex installer registers its marketplace and installs the native plugin.
cases.notes: Inspect codex-plugin-install, the install coordinator, focused tests, and public Codex installation docs; harness generation changes only if the packaged catalog changes.

cases.task: Change the Codex package to declare a new provider-lifecycle enforcement limitation.
cases.notes: The public behavior is the Codex artifact; memory provides the cross-cutting contract.

cases.task: Change the architectural-grilling activation gate and its required-skill health rule.
cases.notes: The workflow owns any material unresolved product or architecture decision; the CLI owns installation and health of mandatory external skills.

cases.task: In src/harness/adapters/codex.ts, adjust retry wording for a delegated task.
cases.notes: The explicit path wins over retry/delegated vocabulary; review prompts only if the common contract changes.

cases.task: Change a Zod schema under .agents/skills/zod/.
cases.notes: The explicit path activates .agents/skills/zod/AGENTS.md; do not create a global route for a local overlay.

cases.task: Find where an unfamiliar requested behavior is implemented when its local source, effective flow, and responsible subsystem are unknown.
cases.ownership_rationale: Unknown local source, flow, or responsibility triggers Explorer before root repository search.
cases.notes: The discovery envelope may name an unknown location. Root supplies the question, read-only bounds, and sufficient return evidence without exploratory pre-reading.

cases.task: Correct one known typo in a specific README sentence and run the already-known focused link check.
cases.ownership_rationale: Source, scope, and verification are known; the authorized minimal low-risk edit requires no discovery or independent judgment.
cases.notes: This is the bounded direct exception, not a continuity or file-count rule.

cases.task: A root consultation starts at a known prompt contract, then answering it requires following an uninspected adapter dependency.

ready: bounded delegation of the unresolved dependency

cases.notes: Another search or dependency ends the direct exception; accumulated context, coordination overhead, and file count do not extend it.

cases.task: A specialist returns a useful conclusion with one unsupported compatibility claim after otherwise sufficient discovery.

ready: request support for the identified compatibility claim

cases.notes: Root targets only missing support or bounded identified evidence; it does not reread every file. Mandatory independent verification remains separate.

cases.task: Improve the responsive settings panel interaction and visually verify keyboard and mobile states.
cases.ownership_rationale: The bounded user-facing surface benefits from designer specialization and isolated visual verification within direct work.
cases.notes: select designer; visual QA does not replace any independent verification required by material risk.

cases.task: Rename the already-identified export in src/agents/prompt-sections.ts and run its focused prompt-rendering test; do not change routing behavior.
cases.ownership_rationale: The exact file and symbol are known, the edit is isolated, and Worker avoids loading unrelated planning context.
cases.notes: Worker owns the bounded edit regardless of route; root coordinates focused verification unless material risk requires a fresh Oracle.

cases.task: Change a shared multi-harness routing contract with edge cases across adapters and installers.
cases.ownership_rationale: A fresh Worker context improves correctness across the coupled contract and adapters even though the work does not need persistence.
cases.notes: select one Worker writer because compatibility-coupled files cannot use overlapping writers.

cases.task: Verify the current official Codex custom-agent selector contract and separate documentation from inference.
cases.ownership_rationale: Current authoritative evidence is an isolated read-only research workstream.
cases.notes: Use librarian for current authoritative external evidence, then confirm local adapter wording.

cases.task: Independently verify a completed artifact-backed implementation against its accepted acceptance criteria.
cases.ownership_rationale: Independent judgment requires a fresh read-only context that did not implement the candidate.
cases.notes: Artifact-backed final verification uses a fresh read-only Oracle that did not implement the change.

cases.task: Implement an unfamiliar local behavior when the source and owner are not yet known.
cases.notes: Explorer first resolves source and responsibility before root repository search; root then selects worker from localized evidence rather than guessing.

cases.task: Own the keyboard focus order and contrast behavior of a bounded checkout dialog and visually verify each interaction state.
cases.ownership_rationale: Interaction and accessibility quality require the designer specialization even though the edit is mechanically small.
cases.notes: Visual and keyboard verification remain part of the bounded writer assignment.

cases.task: Change one already-located configuration default with a literal expected value and run its single focused unit test.
cases.ownership_rationale: The exact target, expected value, and focused check make the implementation lane known and bounded; specialist-default execution routes it to Worker.
cases.notes: Escalate material product or architecture choices to root.

cases.task: Confirm the current official Node support policy before changing a version-sensitive installation statement.
cases.ownership_rationale: The decision depends on current authoritative external evidence rather than local repository discovery.
cases.notes: Return direct official sources and separate inference.

cases.task: The selected specialist cannot start because the native delegation primitive is unavailable.

ready: report the capability gap and preserve bounded work

cases.notes: Delegation failure is reported truthfully and does not silently authorize unrestricted root execution; discovery-tool fallback belongs to the assigned investigator.

cases.task: Research an external contract, inspect a disjoint local adapter, and update an isolated example before synthesizing the migration decision.
cases.notes: Dispatch every ready lane before waiting; synthesis depends on all three terminal results.

cases.task: Generate a contract artifact and only then update the consumer whose exact shape depends on that artifact.
cases.notes: The consumer is not ready until terminal evidence includes the concrete artifact.

cases.task: Two proposed implementation lanes both need to edit the same prompt contract and generated root.
cases.notes: Serialize or combine overlapping mutable ownership instead of claiming parallelism.

cases.task: Five independent read-only checks are ready but the native harness exposes only three execution slots.
cases.notes: Fill current native capacity; refill a freed slot before another wait instead of waiting for the entire set.

cases.task: A native wait times out while a dependent synthesis lane is still blocked on the specialist result.
cases.notes: Timeout and silence are not terminal evidence.

cases.task: The harness cannot prove background dispatch support for two otherwise independent lanes.
cases.notes: Report the native capability gap and proceed sequentially without emulating lifecycle state.
